name: Imperial Armored Shogun
purpose: Endgame Shogun ruler portrait & prestige unlock.
description: Towering armored Shogun with horned kabuto and massive battle naginata, overlooking his kingdom under the blood sun.
prompt: A minimalist 2D graphic illustration for a premium video game, inspired by bold cinematic silhouette poster art. A colossal armored Japanese Shogun warlord in heavy horned kabuto helmet and ornate shoulder armor, holding a towering naginata spear, shown as a powerful near-black silhouette with sharp crimson-red trim highlights. A huge perfectly solid crimson-red circular sun in background, clean hard edges, bold geometric shapes, dramatic negative space, vector game art, no anime, no 3D, no gradients, no text.
